label: Notes
description: Each plushie plays a different musical note when you hold down its button. The plushies can be arranged from low to high to create a musical scale, or lined up to play a melody together.

label: Shake
description: Shake a plushie and watch its lights fill up. Gentle shakes light up just a few LEDs, while harder shakes fill up the whole ring. Each plushie glows in its own random color. Press the button to start over.

label: Shake Rainbow
description: Shake a plushie and watch its lights fill up with a colors based on the intensity of the shake. Gentle shakes light up red, while harder shakes fill up to purple through the rainbow spectrum. Press the button to start over.

label: Jump
description: Hold a plushie while jumping and it counts each jump with its lights. The lights fill up one by one, keeping track up to 12 jumps before starting over. Press the button to reset the count.

label: Rainbow
description: All plushies within range show their battery level in green, then light up with a rainbow pattern at the same time. Use it to get everyone's attention or as a celebration for the whole group.

label: Pattern Plushie
description: The plushies show a pattern of movements or lights and you try to copy it with your own plushie. A fun way to practice following sequences and taking turns.

label: Color Pick
description: Press the button to cycle through different colors, then hold it down to choose your favorite. Each plushie can glow in its own color.

label: Color Stack
description: Build up layers of colors by pressing the button multiple times. Each press adds a new color, creating colorful patterns on your plushie.

label: Freeze Dance
description: One child holds the caller wand and controls the game — when they shake it, everyone dances, and when they hold still, everyone has to freeze. Other children each hold a player wand that tracks whether they're moving or frozen. A full-group game that works across the whole playground.

label: Jump In
description: Kids jump while holding the wand and it lights up in response to their movement. This activity is customizable — teachers can adapt what the wand tracks and how it responds.

label: Cooking
description: Scan ingredient tags with the wand to collect them one at a time, then hold down the button to see what recipe you made. Kids can keep scanning to swap ingredients and try new combinations.

label: Melody Maker
description: Scan note tags to add musical notes to your sequence, then press the button to hear your melody play back. Kids can keep adding notes, erase and start over, or save a song to replay.

label: Wand Moves
description: Kids train the wand to recognize three different movements by practicing each one several times. Once trained, the wand tries to identify which move is being performed and lights up the matching color.

label: Sound Tags
description: Scan NFC tags to play sounds on the wand — each tag triggers its own sound. Teachers set up which tags play which sounds in advance.

label: Stop
description: Stops whatever game the wands are running and returns them to idle mode.
